mapper.sql: AND (${date} > a.base_date OR (${date} = a.base_date AND ${alias}.created_at > a.base_at)) AND ${date} <= #{to}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.name, a.is_default AS "isDefault", a.base_balance AS "baseBalance", to_char(a.base_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "baseDate", a.base_balance + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (e.type = 'INCOME') != e.refund THEN e.amount ELSE -e.amount END) FROM ledger_entry e WHERE e.user_id = a.user_id AND e.account_id = a.id ), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM account_transfer t WHERE t.user_id = a.user_id AND t.to_account_id = a.id ), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM account_transfer t WHERE t.user_id = a.user_id AND t.from_account_id = a.id ), 0) AS "balance" FROM bank_account a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.is_default DESC, a.id

SELECT r.kind, r.id, to_char(r.d, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "date", r.seq, r.amount, r.state AS "balanceState", CASE WHEN r.state IN ('EXACT', 'ESTIMATED') THEN r.total END AS balance, f.name AS "fromAccountName", ta.name AS "toAccountName", t.memo FROM ( SELECT x.kind, x.id, x.d, x.amount, x.involved, row_number() OVER w AS seq,
CASE WHEN u.opening_date IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE u.opening_balance END - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.base_balance), 0) FROM bank_account o WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND NOT o.is_default) + SUM(x.pre) OVER ()
b.base_balance - SUM(x.pre) OVER ()
+ SUM(x.eff) OVER w AS total, CASE WHEN x.d > #{to} THEN 'AFTER_CYCLE' WHEN x.d < u.opening_date THEN 'BEFORE_OPENING' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_account o WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND NOT o.is_defaulto.id = #{accountId} AND (x.d, x.created_at) <= (o.base_date, o.base_at)) THEN 'ESTIMATED' ELSE 'EXACT' END AS state FROM ( SELECT ev.kind, ev.id, ev.d, ev.created_at, SUM(
CASE WHEN ev.ledger AND (u.opening_date IS NULL OR ev.d >= u.opening_date) THEN ev.amt ELSE 0 END - CASE WHEN a.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ev.amt END
CASE WHEN a.id = #{accountId} THEN ev.amt ELSE 0 END ) AS eff, SUM(CASE WHEN (ev.d, ev.created_at) <= (a.base_date, a.base_at) AND a.id = #{accountId} THEN ev.amt ELSE 0 END) AS pre, SUM(CASE WHEN ev.acc = #{accountId} OR ev.acc IS NULL THEN ev.amt ELSE 0 END) AS amount, bool_or(ev.acc = #{accountId} OR ev.acc IS NULL) AS involved FROM ( SELECT 'ENTRY' AS kind, e.id, e.entry_date AS d, e.created_at, CASE WHEN (e.type = 'INCOME') != e.refund THEN e.amount ELSE -e.amount END AS amt, e.account_id AS acc, TRUE AS ledger FROM ledger_entry e WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT 'TRANSFER', t.id, t.transfer_date, t.created_at, t.amount, t.to_account_id, FALSE FROM account_transfer t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT 'TRANSFER', t.id, t.transfer_date, t.created_at, -t.amount, t.from_account_id, FALSE FROM account_transfer t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} ) ev CROSS JOIN app_user u LEFT JOIN bank_account a ON a.id = ev.acc AND NOT a.is_default WHERE u.id = #{userId} GROUP BY ev.kind, ev.id, ev.d, ev.created_at ) x CROSS JOIN app_user u JOIN bank_account b ON b.id = #{accountId} AND b.user_id = #{userId} WHERE u.id = #{userId} WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY x.d, x.created_at, x.kind, x.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) ) r LEFT JOIN account_transfer t ON r.kind = 'TRANSFER' AND t.id = r.id LEFT JOIN bank_account f ON f.id = t.from_account_id LEFT JOIN bank_account ta ON ta.id = t.to_account_id WHERE r.involved ORDER BY r.seq
SELECT id, name, is_default AS "isDefault" FROM bank_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, id

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ledger_entry WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND account_id = #{id}) + (SELECT count(*) FROM recurring_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND account_id = #{id}) + (SELECT count(*) FROM account_transfer WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (from_account_id = #{id} OR to_account_id = #{id}))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bank_account (user_id, name, is_default, base_balance, base_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{isDefault}, #{baseBalance}, #{baseDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE bank_account SET name = #{name}, is_default = #{isDefault}, base_balance = #{baseBalance}, base_date = #{baseDate}, base_at = CASE WHEN base_balance = #{baseBalance} AND base_date = #{baseDate} THEN base_at ELSE now() END WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bank_account WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, to_char(t.transfer_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "transferDate", t.amount, t.memo, t.from_account_id AS "fromAccountId", f.name AS "fromAccountName", t.to_account_id AS "toAccountId", ta.name AS "toAccountName", EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recurring_transfer_run r WHERE r.transfer_id = t.id) AS "recurring" FROM account_transfer t JOIN bank_account f ON f.id = t.from_account_id JOIN bank_account ta ON ta.id = t.to_account_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.transfer_date DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_transfer (user_id, transfer_date, from_account_id, to_account_id, amount, memo) VALUES (#{userId}, #{transferDate}, #{fromAccountId}, #{toAccountId}, #{amount}, #{memo})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM account_transfer WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.sql: r.id, r.amount, r.day_of_month AS "dayOfMonth", r.adjust, r.active, r.memo, r.from_account_id AS "fromAccountId", f.name AS "fromAccountName", r.to_account_id AS "toAccountId", ta.name AS "toAccountName"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM recurring_transfer r JOIN bank_account f ON f.id = r.from_account_id JOIN bank_account ta ON ta.id = r.to_account_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.active DESC, r.day_of_month, r.id

mapper.update: UPDATE recurring_transfer_run SET transfer_id = #{transferId} WHERE recurring_transfer_id = #{recurringId} AND period_ym = #{periodYm}
